description: Full-wave checks for the dual-mode (Potter) horn. step: a 1.033-to-1.300 wavelength step solved by otahub.num.bor_fdtd at 60, 120 and 180 cells per wavelength, against mode matching (otahub.num.waveguide_step). horn: a whole horn (input guide 1.1, step 1.367, phasing 0.583, cone to 5.467 wavelengths, slant 10) in the FDTD's own staircase at 60 and 120 cells per wavelength: raw = TE11/TM11 projections at the aperture plane, corrected = after removing the cone's spherical phase front (the form the aperture model uses); against the stepped-cone cascade (waveguide_step.cascade) and the first-order chain (local propagation constants, no conversion).
